$comment: Single source of truth for Unity versions exercised by CI and tools/check-unity-versions.* local script. Versions are pinned to specific patch releases (no floating tags) per acceptance criteria in CoplayDev/unity-mcp#1107. Every id MUST have a corresponding GameCI Docker image at unityci/editor:ubuntu-<id>-base-3 since both CI (game-ci/unity-test-runner@v4) and local --docker mode pull from there. Verify availability before bumping: https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories/unityci/editor/tags/?name=<id>
$coverageGap: UNITY_6000_5_OR_NEWER and UNITY_6000_6_OR_NEWER branches are NOT exercised by this matrix because GameCI has not yet published Docker images for Unity 6000.5+/6000.6+. Bump the 'rolling' row to a 6000.5+/6000.6+ patch once https://hub.docker.com/r/unityci/editor publishes one. Tracked branches in code: UnityFindObjectsCompat.cs and UnityObjectIdCompat.cs.
$defaultVersionComment: Unity version used when CI runs the narrow matrix (default PR feedback path). Must be one of the ids in 'versions' below. Unity 6.0 LTS is both the package floor and the stable compatibility gate.

versions.notes: Package minimum and Unity 6.0 LTS compatibility gate. UNITY_6000_3/4/5/6_OR_NEWER are OFF.
Latest Unity 6.x available on GameCI. UNITY_6000_3/4_OR_NEWER ON; UNITY_6000_5/6 OFF (no GameCI image yet — see $coverageGap).
